+def count_accounts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, customer_id: int) -> int:
+    """The number of accounts of one customer."""
+    row = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE customer_id = ?", (customer_id,)
+    ).fetchone()
+    return int(row[0])
